verdict.note: Real add/retract/ls/lint/clean run: two readings then two retracts. No line was ever deleted or rewritten — the sidecar grew 2→3→4→5→7 events, each retraction appended with 'retracts' while readings carry 'verdict'. After the first retract the previous reading is latest on ls and lint; after the second the scenario returns to eval-missing; a third retract fails loud (exit 1). A retraction naming no reading is inert. Evidence stays in the referenced set while its reading lives (clean removed 0) and is collected once retracted (clean removed 1).
